verdict.rationale: Twenty's source is publicly hosted on GitHub (github.com/twentyhq/twenty), and its install script is pulled from that repo's main branch, so the source is readable. The open license is evidenced only by community comments: one HN user names it AGPLv3 and another calls it open source. missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license (e.g., a LICENSE file or docs page declaring AGPLv3), and first-party docs on source-code access or contribution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Massive difference exist between GPLv2 (Git) vs AGPLv3 (Twenty).
It's great to have more open source platforms in the CRM space.
